clearance.method: Exact cooked SAPIEN triangle-pair vertex/face, edge/edge and edge/triangle intersection; AABB-pruned at 20 mm. Distances >=20 mm reported as lower bounds. PhysX contact manifolds measured separately at each saved pose.

force.method: CPU 1ms SAPIEN, exact accepted Z->v3 LS states. Start in accepted hold with neutral gamepad, interpolate robot drive targets hold->push over 1s then 0.5s settle. Contact force = impulse / 0.001 s; sum all robot->stick contact vectors then absolute projection onto current click joint axis. No gamepad qpos assignment after reset.

forces-gamepad-contact.force_limit_unit: Nm per revolute joint, not N at fingertip
